title: Shift to the left response of granulocytes in blood smear (human) | Health Education Assets Library (HEAL)
description: Stain: May-Grnwald-Giemsa (MGG). During infection a shift towards a relative increase of the number of neutrophilic granulocytes (3) with reduced lobulation of the nuclei and immature white cells, occurs in blood. (1) promonocyte. (2) (pro)myelocyte.
